title: Coast Guard Responds to 4 Adults, 3 Children on Sinking Boat Near Texas/Louisiana Border
description: Coast Guard crews from Sabine Pass, Houston and Corpus Christi jumped into action to rescue four adults and three children after a report that their boat began to sink 20 miles southeast of the Cameron Jetties in Louisiana, July 30, 2015. Sector Houston-Galveston watchstanders launched a 45-foot rescue boat from Station Sabine, two MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crews from Coast Guard Air Station Houston and an HC-144 Ocean Sentry airplane to respond. U.S. Coast Guard video by Coast Guard Air Station Houston.
